subject: history
concept: Understanding that different communities around the world have different customs and traditions
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student explores a real or illustrative tradition/custom from a community different from their own
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a tradition to the description of what it celebrates or represents
exercise.abstract: Student describes one tradition or custom and shows respectful curiosity about it

assessment.success_marker: student engages respectfully and curiously with a tradition different from their own
